notes.overrides: components/ui and components/reui are the design system itself (installed by the shadcn CLI, edited in place): they write the classes everyone else may not restyle, and stock components use arbitrary values, inline styles for measured geometry and runtime-built classes by design (data-grid, charts, sidebar). So no-restyle, no-arbitrary-values, no-inline-styles and require-static-classes are off inside them; no-raw-colors and no-unknown-classes stay on, since stock code uses tokens.
notes.shadcn/no-restyle: Encodes AGENTS.md's ReUI rule 1 and nothing stricter (docs/refactor/design-decisions.md D10): an installed component keeps its height, padding, radius, shadow and motion. A caller may place it (layout, margins), colour its text and set its type, which the ReUI blocks do in their published markup. Need a size or look the component lacks? Add a variant or size in its file under components/ui or components/reui so every caller gets it. Controls (Button, Input, Badge, TabsTrigger …) also keep their height: a fixed h-*/size-* on one is a size prop that is missing. Skeleton and Spinner are sized by their caller.
notes.shadcn/no-restyle.DialogContent: Overlay content may be given a width and placement (the shadcn idiom sm:max-w-lg), never padding, radius, shadow or motion.
notes.shadcn/no-restyle.CardTitle: Titles are never resized (AGENTS.md, ReUI rule 3).

message.default: {{component}} keeps its own padding, radius, shadow and motion (AGENTS.md, ReUI rule 1): pick variant={{variants}} or size={{sizes}}. A caller may place and size it in its layout (width, height, margins, flex/grid position), colour its text and set its type.

{{component}} keeps its own height, padding, radius, shadow and motion (AGENTS.md, ReUI rule 1): pick variant={{variants}} or size={{sizes}}. A caller may place it (width, margins, flex/grid position), colour its text and set its type.
{{component}} is sized by its caller; it never takes a shadow or motion.
{{component}} owns its padding, radius, shadow and motion. A caller may set its width and placement (sm:max-w-lg, max-h-[85vh] overflow-hidden) and nothing else.
{{component}} is never resized (AGENTS.md, ReUI rule 3): leave its size, weight and leading to the component.
